title: Software Engineer Sênior
description:
Sobre a Trinio

Sobre a Trinio A Trinio é uma empresa de tecnologia, remote first, com a missão de criar novas experiências e tecnologias que capacitem os e-commerces a construir relacionamentos melhores e duradouros diretamente com seus clientes. Nossas aplicações buscam otimizar diferentes partes do fluxo de compra, desde a decisão de compra até a otimização dos custos e processo para a entrega do pedido. Queremos mudar o paradigma das compras em um mercado que perde bilhões de reais em GMV todos os anos devido a experiências ruins de compra e processo inadequados.

A empresa foi fundada em 2022 por dois MBAs de Wharton e empreendedores de segunda e terceira viagem. Nosso CEO é um engenheiro de software com mais de 15 anos de experiência em programação e desenvolvimento de produtos tecnológicos. Contamos com o apoio de fundos de investimento americanos, europeus e locais, além de investidores-anjo estratégicos. Nosso time altamente talentoso vem de diferentes indústrias e áreas de especialização, tendo trabalhado em empresas como VTEX, Adyen, Nubank, Arquivei, Cortex, WeWork, Vanguard, Avenue, Modal e muitas outras. Atualmente atendemos vários clientes como Vivara, Karsten, Michael Kors, Oficina Reserva, Trussardi entre outros.

Nossa Cultura e Valores

Acreditamos que, para alcançar nossos objetivos, é essencial ter uma cultura inclusiva e forte. O Produto Principal da Trinio é Deep Tech e, para termos sucesso, estamos totalmente comprometidos em construir uma equipe talentosa, tecnicamente e intelectualmente curiosa, alinhada com nossos valores fundamentais.

  • Thoughts inspire innovation - Science makes it real
  • Building experiences, not products. For everyone
  • Fast-paced commitment and execution
  • Frictionless & constructive communication

Principais atividades

  • Ajudar nosso time a desenvolver nossos produtos
  • Corrigir bugs
  • Desenhar bancos de dados
  • Desenvolver ferramentas internas
  • Manter sistemas produtivos
  • Participar de decisões de design, arquitetura de novos microsserviços e priorização
  • Aprender continuamente sobre novas tecnologias
  • Sugerir maneiras melhores de fazer as coisas

Experiência e habilidades necessárias

  • 7+ anos de experiência
  • TypeScript | Javascript | React | Next.js
  • Node.js (Nest.js)
  • Golang
  • AWS e GCP
  • gRPC
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • Prática em testes
  • Inglês (leitura e escrita proficiente, conversação intermediária)

Seu perfil pode se destacar ainda mais se você

  • Tiver experiência em startups Series A ou posterior
  • Tiver experiência com e-commerce, antifraude ou pagamentos
  • Contribuir para um projeto de código aberto
  • Tiver um projeto pessoal
  • Trabalhou em uma startup fast-paced ou scale-up

O que esperamos de você

  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e organização, com facilidade para atuar de forma transversal entre áreas e stakeholders com diferentes prazos e prioridades
  • Confortável em lidar com múltiplos projetos e demandas simultâneas
  • Perfil proativo, com interesse em aprendizado contínuo
  • Curiosidade intelectual e vontade de entender o negócio além dos números

  • Self driven (confortável em ambientes com pouca orientação)
  • Team player
  • Ser uma referência e uma inspiração para engenheiros mais juniores

Benefícios e localização

Stord is the leading commerce enablement provider of fulfillment services and technology that powers seamless checkout and delivery experiences for high-volume mid-market and enterprise brands across all channels. Stord manages over $5 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. With Stord, brands can sell more, save money, and reduce headaches.


With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.


Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, Native, Tula, American Giant, and more trust Stord to make their supply chains a competitive advantage. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, and Salesforce Ventures.

Join our dynamic team as a talented and fast-paced engineer and play a pivotal role in our product expansion.
At Stord, engineers are empowered to own entire features, influencing specifications, building and enhancing our Elixir/Phoenix back-end, and collaborating with the React front-end. You'll be instrumental in the ongoing improvement of a product that is revolutionizing the third-party logistics (3PL) industry. Leading omni-channel brands rely on our innovative, world-class logistics network software to optimize their warehouse processes and order fulfillment, leveraging its powerful automations and order management tools to achieve cost savings and operational excellence.

What You'll Do:

  • Drive the evolution of the Stord platform by owning the complete lifecycle of new features: from conception and testing to iterative delivery.

  • Contribute to and enhance both our robust back-end (Elixir/Phoenix) and engaging front-end (React) services.

  • Partner with teams across the organization to gain deep insights into customer and vendor needs, develop effective solutions, and rapidly bring them to life through prototyping, iteration, and launch.

  • Collaborate with a team of bright and driven individuals who are passionate about delivering exceptional work.

  • Engage with and solve a wide spectrum of challenging technical and groundbreaking supply chain problems.

What You'll Need:

  • A genuine passion for building exceptional software that provides outstanding user experiences.

  • Highly effective communication skills to articulate ideas and collaborate effectively.

  • A strong belief in the value of test-driven development and collaborative code reviews.

  • The ability to adapt quickly and thrive in the dynamic environment of a startup.

  • A minimum of 5 years of professional experience with Elixir or other functional programming paradigms.

  • Solid experience with Model-View-Controller (MVC) frameworks.

  • Experience in transforming design wireframes into fully functional production features.

  • The ability to produce clean, dependable, and easily maintainable code.

  • A strong intrinsic motivation to tackle and resolve complex issues.

Bonus Points:

  • Previous startup experience

  • Previous logistics or supply chain experience

*This role is ONLY open to candidates residing in Latin America (LATAM) OR Europe (EU)

title: Execution & Enablement Manager - EMEA
description:
Overview

Why should you join dLocal?

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.

By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being a part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.

What’s the opportunity?

Lead operational excellence across dLocal’s Payins network by building and managing long-term, value-driven relationships with processors, acquirers, APM providers, card schemes, and issuers.

Be the primary operational partner manager for key partners, owning partner health, performance improvements, and commercial outcomes.

Work cross-functionally (Customer Success, Commercial AMs, Product, Compliance, Global Payins) to reduce costs, increase approvals and reliability, and deliver best-in-class merchant go-lives.

Drive measurable impact: improve approval rates, reduce latency and costs, lower incident escalation, and accelerate merchant time-to-revenue.

Lead the end-to-end process of identifying, evaluating, negotiating, and implementing new payment methods, as well as optimizing existing solutions, to ensure continuous operational excellence and seamless integration across the business.

What will I be doing?

  • Partner & processor management
    • Own day-to-day operational relationship for assigned partners: onboarding, credential/contract changes, operational migrations, and go-live readiness.
    • Coordinate root-cause investigations and remediation with partners and internal teams to resolve business and technical blockers.
    • Coordinate with Business Assurance and relay processor feedback; support market-specific needs and practices to improve continuity.
  • Enablement & commercial responsibilities
    • Negotiate pricing, SLAs and special commercial terms; enable partner features and new payment flows.
    • Manage the fines process: track, upload evidence, and ensure card-scheme mandates are implemented.
  • Merchant-facing operational support
    • Provide hands-on enablement and hypercare for merchant integrations and go-lives; act as the escalation contact for CS and AM teams during critical incidents.
  • Performance optimization & market intelligence
    • Analyze rejection reasons, partner performance, and routing to implement initiatives that increase approvals and reduce costs.
    • Identify and help integrate new operational capabilities (new tenders, features) and benchmark partner performance against market standards.
  • Governance, reporting & continuous improvement
    • Maintain and drive the Partners Health Matrix; run health reviews and deliver action plans.
    • Report progress, risks and outcomes to stakeholders; own core KPIs and continuous improvement initiatives.

What skills do I need?

  • 4–6+ years in payments/fintech operations, partner/processor or issuing and acquiring management (experience with card schemes and APMs strongly preferred).
  • Proven ability to negotiate pricing, SLAs and commercial agreements with partners.
  • Strong understanding of payment flows and operations (APIs, webhooks, credentials, routing, settlement, reconciliation); comfortable working with Product and Engineering.
  • Data-driven mindset with strong root-cause analysis skills.
  • Proficient with Excel/Sheets; SQL or BI tools a plus.
  • Working knowledge of scheme mandates, fines processes, and operational compliance (AML/KYC considerations).
  • Excellent communication and ability to influence across functions and with external partners.
  • Experience leading cross-functional programs, merchant go-lives, and driving actions under tight timelines.
  • Bias for action, ownership, strong organisation, and ability to operate across time zones and manage multiple initiatives.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or related field; fluency in English (additional languages a plus).

What do we offer?

Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you:

  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe!
  • Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance.
  • Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity.
  • Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded.
  • Learning & development: get access to a Premium Coursera subscription.
  • Language classes: we provide free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes.
  • Social budget: you\'ll get a monthly budget to chill out with your team (in person or remotely) and deepen your connections!
  • dLocal Houses: want to rent a house to spend one week anywhere in the world coworking with your team? We’ve got your back!
  • For people based in Montevideo (Uruguay) applying to non-IT roles, 55% monthly attendance to the office is required

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

Also, you can check out our revised page, LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube for more about dLocal!

title: Página da Vaga | Analista de Cyber Security Senior (Inteligência e Investigação cibernéticas)
description:
Job description

Modelo de trabalho:

Modelo de trabalho 100% remoto

Sobre o time:

O time de segurança cibernética adiciona valor por meio do objetivo de proteção dos ativos, isso significa oferecer produtos, plataformas e serviços de maneira segura seguindo os princípios de confidencialidade, integridade e disponibilidade.

Desafios da posição:

  • Estruturar e liderar a frente de gestão de ameaças (threat intelligence, threat hunting e threat modeling), sendo o ponto focal para a proteção proativa contra fraudes digitais, vazamento de dados e ataques direcionados.
  • Desenvolver uma capacidade de "caça" a ameaças (threat hunting) do zero, buscando ativamente por atividades maliciosas e comprometimentos que possam passar despercebidos pelos sistemas de segurança tradicionais.
  • Conduzir investigações cibernéticas complexas para entender a fundo a causa raiz de incidentes, mapear o impacto e traduzir os aprendizados em melhorias concretas de controles e processos para as equipes de tecnologia.

Main responsibilities

Seu dia a dia na Conta Simples:

Threat Management (Threat Intelligence, Hunting e Modeling)

  • Desenvolver e gerenciar o programa de threat intelligence para identificar, analisar e monitorar ameaças cibernéticas relevantes para Conta Simples.
  • Conduzir monitoramento contínuo em threat intelligence via fontes externas (surface e non-surface web) com a finalidade de atuação para detectar dados vazados e campanhas de ameaças cibernéticas.
  • Desenvolver e gerenciar o programa de threat hunting proativo em ambientes de nuvem e ambientes corporativos, com o intuito de desenvolver hipóteses de ataque para buscar por Indicadores de Comprometimento (IoCs) e Indicadores de Ataque (IoAs).
  • Conduzir iniciativas de threat modeling por meio de mapeamento dos fluxos críticos do negócio e levantamento de hipóteses de um atacante real sobre como poderia explorá-los, considerando o atual superfície de ataque, arquitetura e processos operacionais.
  • Conduzir iniciativas de practical check onde a partir dos vetores identificados (threat modelling) criamos casos de testes práticos que simulam ataques reais aos fluxos críticos, sejam eles técnicos (como escalonamentos, movimentações laterais e bypasses) ou operacionais (como falhas em processos de conciliação ou fraudes internas).
  • Diagnóstico de threat modelling externos: a partir de principais ataques cibernéticos públicos, identificar vetores de ataque, atores maliciosos e entender quais medidas de segurança internas precisam ser revisitadas visando aumentar a maturidade de segurança da Conta Simples.
  • Investigar anomalias como credenciais não reconhecidas em instâncias lambdas, backdoors, possíveis execuções de código remoto (RCE) e outras ameaças avançadas.

Investigação Cibernética

  • Conduzir análises de logs e forenses para reconstruir a linha do tempo de incidentes, como o cadastro de um novo usuário ou dispositivo não reconhecido por um cliente.
  • Elaborar dossiês de comprometimento detalhados, documentando a causa raiz, o impacto e as ações de contenção e erradicação.
  • Colaborar com demais equipes envolvidas em investigações cibernéticas para sugerir melhorias concretas de controles de segurança, como gerenciamento de logs e correlação de eventos para evitar a recorrência de problemas.
  • Produzir relatórios e briefings sobre o cenário de ameaças e o resultado das investigações para stakeholders técnicos e executivos.

Requirements and skills

O que esperamos de você:

  • Sólida experiência em posições de Cyber Segurança, com foco comprovado em Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting e/ou Resposta a Incidentes.
  • Profundo conhecimento do framework MITRE ATT&CK e da Cyber Kill Chain.
  • Experiência prática em plataformas de Threat Intelligence e ferramentas de segurança como SIEM e EDR.
  • Domínio em análise de logs de diversas fontes
  • Conhecimento prático em ambientes de nuvem e seus respectivos serviços
  • Familiaridade com técnicas de monitoramento da deep & dark web.
  • Habilidade para escrever scripts para automação de tarefas de análise.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de produzir relatórios técnicos claros e objetivos.
  • Perfil analítico, investigativo, proativo e com forte senso de urgência.

Será diferencial se você tiver:

  • Certificações de mercado como Security+, CEH, OSCP ou similares.
  • Experiência prévia no setor financeiro ou em fintechs.
  • Conhecimento em análise forense.
  • Inglês avançado para leitura técnica e interação com comunidades de segurança.

title: mbar Energia - Operador Usina Termoelétrica
description:
Overview

Somos a Âmbar, a empresa de geração e comercialização de energia do grupo J&F, o maior grupo privado do Brasil. Nosso amplo portfólio de ativos contribui para a expansão e diversificação da matriz energética do Brasil.

Temos 39 unidades de geração de energia, essenciais para a segurança no abastecimento de eletricidade. Nossas usinas fortalecem a transição energética sustentável para o país e para os nossos clientes. Somos o quarto maior gerador de energia a gás natural do Brasil em capacidade instalada. Possuímos ainda unidades hidrelétricas, solares, a biomassa, a carvão mineral e a biogás.

Respaldados pela solidez do grupo J&F, atuamos na comercialização de energia no Mercado Livre e em projetos de Geração Distribuída para clientes em todo o Brasil. Atuamos na gestão completa das contas, criando soluções personalizadas para consumidores e empresas de todos os portes.

Presente em mais de 190 países e com 70 anos de história, o grupo J&F tem um portfólio amplo de empresas. Entre elas estão a JBS, líder global em alimentos à base de proteína, além da Eldorado Brasil Celulose, J&F Mineração, Flora Higiene e Cosméticos, Picpay, Banco Original e Canal Rural.

Estamos em expansão e buscamos profissional para atuar como Operador Usina Termoelétrica em nossa Usina em Santa Cruz, Rio de Janeiro. Será responsável por executar as atividades de operação dos turbogeradores a gás e vapor, caldeiras de recuperação de calor, estações de tratamento e desmineralização de água, estação de tratamento de efluentes, subestação e todos os demais sistemas auxiliares da planta, a fim de garantir o cumprimento com o despacho e a disponibilidade da planta de modo seguro e confiável.

Main responsibilities

  • Executar as rotinas operacionais (testes funcionais, rondas, preenchimento de relatórios, relacionamento com os agentes ONS, Energisa e Eletronorte), de acordo com os procedimentos e instruções P-OP-01, visando assegurar que as rotinas são executadas dentro dos padrões de qualidade e segurança da empresa;
  • Executar a operação e conservação do ciclo combinado, de acordo com os procedimentos e instruções P-OP-08, cumprindo com o programa de geração estabelecido pelo ONS, a fim de garantir a disponibilidade da planta;
  • Executar a operação e conservação das turbinas a gás e seus auxiliares, de forma remota (supervisório na sala de controle) e local (em campo), de acordo com os procedimentos e instruções P-OP-09, de forma confiável e segura, visando cumprir com a disponibilidade da planta, através de um índice de controle e com os requisitos de qualidade de emissões atmosféricas exigidos no processo, evitando danificar os equipamentos;
  • Executar a operação e conservação das caldeiras (HRSG) e seus auxiliares, de acordo com os procedimentos e instruções P-OP-10, de forma confiável e segura visando assegurar o bom funcionamento dos equipamentos em geral para geração de energia;
  • Executar a operação e conservação do ciclo água-vapor, de acordo com os procedimentos e instruções P-OP-11, de forma confiável e segura, visando cumprir com os requisitos de qualidade de água e vapor exigidos no processo, necessários para a vida útil das caldeiras;
  • Executar a operação e conservação da turbina a vapor e seus auxiliares, de acordo com os procedimentos e instruções P-OP-12, visando cumprir com a disponibilidade da planta e com os requisitos de qualidade de vapor exigidos;
  • Executar a operação e conservação da planta de desmineralização de água (DESMI), de acordo com os procedimentos e instruções P-OP-13, visando cumprir com os requisitos de qualidade de água necessários para a vida útil das caldeiras;
  • Executar a operação e conservação da estação de tratamento de água (ETA), de acordo com os procedimentos e instruções P-OP-14, de forma confiável e segura visando cumprir com os requisitos de qualidade de água exigidos para a vida útil da torre de resfriamento e do condensador da turbina a vapor;
  • Executar a operação e conservação da planta de óleo combustível (descarregamento, tratamento e armazenagem), de acordo com os procedimentos e instruções P-OP-15, de forma confiável e segura visando cumprir com os requisitos de qualidade de óleo exigidos para a vida útil das turbinas a gás e nível de emissões atmosféricas;
  • Executar a operação e conservação da estação de tratamento de efluentes (ETE), de acordo com os procedimentos e instruções P-OP-16, de forma confiável e segura visando cumprir com os requisitos de qualidade de água estabelecidos pelo órgão ambiental;
  • Coletar amostras e encaminhar para análises químicas e, quando necessário, esporadicamente executar as análises, para garantir os padrões de qualidade de água e vapor exigidos em todos os processos da planta, com os procedimentos e instruções P-OP-17;
  • Executar manobras nos barramentos elétricos da planta e preencher os relatórios, de acordo com os procedimentos e instruções P-OP-19, de forma confiável e segura visando cumprir com a disponibilidade da planta;
  • Auxiliar o supervisor de turno na execução de pequenas intervenções em equipamentos, visando garantir a disponibilidade da planta;
  • Realizar rondas na planta e informar as ocorrências ao supervisor de turno, a fim de garantir que as devidas ações corretivas sejam tomadas e cumprir com a disponibilidade da planta;
  • Executar descarregamento de produtos químicos, de acordo com os procedimentos e instruções P-AL-05, de forma confiável e segura conforme os padrões de qualidade e segurança da empresa;
  • Realizar, quando necessário, o preenchimento dos livros de ocorrências da planta, visando a consistência dos relatos das ocorrências no respectivo turno;
  • Auxiliar o supervisor de turno na execução das isolações de equipamentos e sistemas (lock-out tag-out), de acordo com a instrução de segurança I-SE-0-2.16, assegurando execução dos serviços dentro dos padrões de segurança da empresa.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Médio Técnico Completo;
  • Formação Específica em Eletrônica, Mecânica, eletromecânica, eletrotécnica ou Química;
  • Necessário experiência anterior como Operador em Usinas;
  • Saber interpretar o diagrama elétrico unifilar da planta e identificar os principais barramentos (no diagrama e em campo), sua função e importância;
  • Saber identificar as tubulações de vapor na caldeira, pipe-rack e turbina à vapor (HP, IP,LP, cold e hot re-heater);
  • Saber o KKS e a localização física das principais válvulas das caldeiras;
  • Saber operar a estação de tratamento de água, incluindo controle analítico do processo (dosagem de químicos, qualidade da água, retrolavagem e tratamento de lodo);
  • Saber operar a planta de desmineralização de água, incluindo controle analítico do processo (dosagem de químicos, qualidade da água, regeneração e neutralização);
  • Saber realizar o alinhamento completo e coleta de amostras de água e vapor.

Remoto, desde cualquier país hispanohablante de América Latina.

title: Regional Expansion Manager - Central Africa ( Based in  Lagos, Nigeria)
description:
Overview

Why should you join dLocal?

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.

By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being a part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven professional to lead our partnerships and market operations in Nigeria and Central Africa. The role involves building and managing strategic relationships with acquirers, banks, regulators, and merchants, while driving operational excellence and ensuring compliance in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

What you will do

  • Identify, engage, and cultivate relationships with potential partners — including acquirers and banks.
  • Negotiate, structure, and execute commercial partnerships and agreements.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (operations, product, and technology) to align partnership integrations with the product and technology roadmap.
  • Monitor partnership performance, analyze results, and optimize strategies for improved outcomes.
  • Enhance operational capabilities across multiple payment methods.
  • Stay informed on local regulatory and licensing requirements, ensuring ongoing compliance and advising on potential business impacts.
  • Work closely with merchants and the commercial team to develop and enhance key products.
  • Maintain strong professional networks, attend industry events, and represent the company in relevant forums.
  • Liaise with local lawyers, accountants, and tax advisors to ensure smooth operational compliance.
  • Actively engage with regulators to build constructive relationships and facilitate business operations.

What we are looking for

  • Minimum 8+ years’ experience in payments, fintech, or financial services, with a strong track record in Africa.
  • Proven success in building partnerships and executing high-value commercial agreements.
  • Established business network within the financial and payments ecosystem.
  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and drive initiatives across diverse teams and time zones.
  • Strong negotiation, relationship management, and strategic thinking skills.
  • Comfortable working in fast-changing, ambiguous environments and taking calculated risks.
  • In-depth knowledge of the African market and regulatory landscape.
  • Technical knowledge related to payment systems is a plus.
  • Commitment to compliance and regulatory adherence.
  • Positive, curious, and collaborative team player capable of leading projects or contributing effectively as part of a team.

What do we offer?

Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you:

  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe!
  • Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance.
  • Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity.
  • Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded.
  • Learning & development: get access to a Premium Coursera subscription.
  • Language classes: we provide free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes.
  • Social budget: you\'ll get a monthly budget to chill out with your team (in person or remotely) and deepen your connections!
  • dLocal Houses: want to rent a house to spend one week anywhere in the world coworking with your team? We’ve got your back!
  • For people based in Montevideo (Uruguay) applying to non-IT roles, 55% monthly attendance to the office is required

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

Also, you can check out our webpage, LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube for more about dLocal!

title: Remote Support Specialist Associate
description:
Overview

At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people’s lives every day. We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.

As a global leader in food processing and packaging, Tetra Pak delivers cutting-edge solutions that ensure food safety and quality across the globe. Our success is driven not only by our advanced technologies, but also by the people behind them—professionals who are passionate about innovation and committed to protecting what’s good. Within our global Services organization, the Remote Support Hub is a key part of Next Generation Service Operations, providing 24/7 technical support to customers in over 160 countries.

As a Remote Support Specialist Associate , you will join a team of experts who resolve the most complex and critical cases escalated from our customers’ production sites. Working closely with senior specialists, you will learn how to diagnose and solve advanced automation and equipment issues using industry-leading digital tools and methodologies in the food and beverage industry, helping customers keep their high-speed production lines running efficiently. This position offers a unique opportunity to learn how our equipment and automation systems operate as a whole, combining mechanical and digital components to deliver reliable performance. You will be trained in our automation platforms and programming tools, and gradually take on more responsibility as you grow.

You will interact remotely with customers and internal teams, gaining exposure to global best practices and contributing to solutions that keep food safe and available everywhere. As part of Tetra Pak’s Next Generation strategy, you will be empowered to learn, collaborate, and make a difference from day one, building the foundation for a successful career in a dynamic, innovative, and customer-focused organization. The role is designed for recent graduates with a background in mechatronics, automation, or IT who are curious, hands-on, and eager to understand how industrial systems work in practice. You will interact remotely with customers and internal teams, gaining exposure to real-world challenges and contributing to solutions that have a direct impact on food production around the world. This is a development position, and we are looking for individuals who want to build their careers by learning, collaborating, and making a difference.

This position will be based in Monte Mor, SP. Tetra Pak does not offer visa or relocation support for this position.

We strongly encourage applications from individuals belonging to underrepresented or minorized groups, including women, Black, Indigenous, LGBTQ+ people, people with disabilities, and others.

What you will do

As a Remote Support Specialist Associate, you will:

  • Participate in the remote resolution of complex automation cases via phone, chat, and email for customers and Tetra Pak field teams;
  • Lead remote troubleshooting sessions, document solutions, and ensure customer satisfaction before closing support cases;
  • Collaborate with field engineers and global competence networks to share knowledge and drive continuous improvement;
  • Support initiatives to enhance equipment reliability, availability, and performance;
  • Continuously develop your technical and problem-solving skills through training and project participation.

We believe you have

  • Recent graduate in Mechatronics, Automation, IT, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related fields;
  • Basic knowledge of programming (Python, C++, Pascal, or similar);
  • Interest in automation, industrial equipment, and how mechanical and digital systems work together;
  • Hands-on, curious, eager to learn, and passionate about technology. Enjoys solving problems and working as part of a team;
  • Strong communication, customer focus, attention to detail, and willingness to take initiative.

We Offer You

  • A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape
  • A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results
  • An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion
  • Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements

Apply Now

If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at .

This job posting expires on October 19, 2025.

Diversity, equity, and inclusion is an everyday part of how we work. We give people a place to belong and support to thrive, an environment where everyone can be comfortable being themselves and has equal opportunities to grow and succeed. We embrace difference, celebrate people for who they are, and for the diversity they bring that helps us better understand and connect with our customers and communities worldwide.

Overview

Join our close-knit LATAM remote team. Connect through activities like coffee breaks, tech talks, and games with your teammates and management. We champion autonomy, open communication, and respect for diversity as our core values. Our People Care team supports you from day one, from time-off requests to wellness check-ins. Our Accounts Management team ensures smooth, effective client relationships, so you can focus on what you do best.

Ready to grow with us?

About the project

As a Business Analyst , you will contribute to the design, development, and deployment of a cutting-edge preventative security platform for a high-profile client, enhancing security posture across cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) and hybrid environments.

How you’ll contribute

  • Conduct in-depth interviews, workshops, and brainstorming sessions to elicit, analyze, and document functional and non-functional requirements, ensuring measurable value
  • Analyze current-state security processes, identify gaps, and envision future-state solutions aligned with the client's strategic goals

  • Create comprehensive documentation (BRDs, FSDs, Use Cases, User Stories, Process Flows) with precision and clarity
  • Collaborate with the client’s engineering team and technical resources to translate requirements into robust designs and solutions

This would make you the ideal candidate

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • 8+ years of experience as a Business Analyst in client-facing consulting, ideally with cybersecurity or platform development

  • Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and hybrid infrastructures
  • Proficiency with business analysis tools (JIRA, Confluence, Visio, Lucidchart, etc.)
  • Ability to work independently and in a cross-functional, fast-paced consulting environment
  • Advanced English level required for work with US clients

What to expect from our hiring process

  1. Let’s chat about your experience
  2. Impress our recruiters, then a technical interview with our top developers
  3. Meet with our client for the final step

description:
Job description

Somos a Âmbar, a empresa de geração e comercialização de energia do grupo J&F, o maior grupo privado do Brasil. Nosso amplo portfólio de ativos contribui para a expansão e diversificação da matriz energética do Brasil.

Temos 39 unidades de geração de energia, essenciais para a segurança no abastecimento de eletricidade. Nossas usinas fortalecem a transição energética sustentável para o país e para os nossos clientes. Somos o quarto maior gerador de energia a gás natural do Brasil em capacidade instalada. Possuímos ainda unidades hidrelétricas, solares, a biomassa, o carvão mineral e a biogás.

Prespondemos pela solidez do grupo J&F, atuamos na comercialização de energia no Mercado Livre e em projetos de Geração Distribuída para clientes em todo o Brasil. Atuamos na gestão completa das contas, criando soluções personalizadas para consumidores e empresas de todos os portes.

Presente em mais de 190 países e com 70 anos de história, o grupo J&F tem um portfólio amplo de empresas. Entre elas estão a JBS, líder global em alimentos à base de proteína, além da Eldorado Brasil Celulose, J&F Mineração, Flora Higiene e Cosméticos, Picpay, Banco Original e Canal Rural.

Estamos em busca de um Mecânico que irá executar a manutenção mecânica preventiva, preditiva e corretiva em todos os equipamentos da usina, conforme as ordens de serviços de manutenção originadas pelo programa anual de manutenção, bem como as solicitações das ocorrências diárias de manutenção, com o intuito de atingir as metas de disponibilidade dos equipamentos.

Main responsibilities

  • Realizar as manutenções, preventiva, corretiva e preditiva de guisa segura, em equipamentos mecânicos tais como: turbina a gás e vapor, geradores e sistemas auxiliares, ETA, ETE, planta de desmineralização e de tratamento de óleo, compressores, válvulas, bombas, filtros, trocadores de calor, caldeiras HRSG, utilizando a de referência do plano de manutenção e das ordens de serviços, com o propósito de evitar problemas que causem paralização dos equipamentos e respectivamente da produção;
  • Preditiva, analisar e diagnosticar possíveis problemas em equipamentos, através de relatórios conclusivos, obtendo o diagnóstico em questão, a fim da tomada de decisão para resolução;
  • Analisar e medir as vibrações mecânicas nos equipamentos da usina, identificando folgas, desalinhamento das engrenagens dos mesmos, a fim de realizar reparos necessários;
  • Realizar análise de temperaturas dos equipamentos e identificar possíveis motivos de sobrecarga nos mesmos, a fim de sugerir a intervenção de manutenção devida para solucionar o problema;
  • Executar o plano de lubrificação mensal dos equipamentos, seguindo uma rota sequencial para este trabalho, a fim de evitar paralisações dos equipamentos causando prejuízos;
  • Garantir a qualidade dos serviços de manutenção prestados, através da obediência aos procedimentos da organização, a fim de manter a excelência dos resultados;
  • Auxiliar a melhoria contínua dos sistemas, através da implementação de projetos e modificações de rotinas e equipamentos, a fim de obter uma otimização rumo aos resultados;
  • Garantir a melhoria contínua da gestão de saúde, segurança, meio ambiente e social, seguindo a política de SSMA da empresa, reportando acidentes potenciais (quase acidentes, atos e condições inseguras), participando de reuniões e treinamentos de SSMA e tomando medidas que visem atenuar os riscos à saúde e segurança dos colaboradores e contratados em potencias impactos ambientais.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Médio/Técnico em Manutenção Mecânica ou Eletromecânica;
  • Necessário experiência em manutenção industrial em usinas termelétricas;
  • Desejável conhecimento em Geradores de Energia, Turbina a Gás e Turbina a Vapor;
  • Conhecimento em Pacote office (Word e Excel);
  • NR10 e o SEP (Sistema Elétrico Potencia);
  • Ferramentaria e Equipamentos de Oficina (Torno, Esmeril e Prensa);
  • Conhecimento em Mecânica Industrial;
  • Conhecimento em Caldeira HRSG;
  • Conhecimento em Hidráulica e Pneumática;
  • Conhecimento de Alinhamento a Laser;
  • Conhecimento em Lubrificação;
  • Conhecimento em Análise de vibração;
  • Capacitação/Habilitação para operação de empilhadeira;
  • Interpretação de Desenho Mecânico.

Job Summary:

Our Inbound Sales Representatives connect and engage with prospective clients who originate from inbound leads. They seek new business opportunities by connecting with, and developing relationships with, potential customers and guiding prospective clients throughout the required sales stages. To excel in this position, you need to effectively communicate and collaborate with clients, ensuring they understand the value of our services and how Toptal can support their goals. Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, is hungry to exceed sales quotas, and strives to go above and beyond. If you are passionate about sales, innately driven, and results-oriented, this is the perfect opportunity for you to launch your sales career.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Sales Cycle Management: You will be the initial face of Toptal and supporting our clients through the required sales stages. As the first point of contact and the initial ‘face’ of Toptal for new clients, you will be responsible for moving these clients forward in the sales process, starting with regularly conducting sales calls. You will be responsible for accurately articulating the benefit of Toptal to potential clients in these calls and managing deal cycles from discovery through close.
  • Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will be responsible for executing upon a customer-centric approach across all of your customer interactions during pre-defined working hours. You will build rapport with our prospective clients, which will require researching clients before outreach and staying on top of industry trends and Toptal competitors.
  • Collaboration with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team to promptly respond to high-volume inbound client inquiries. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB sales team members always look to improve individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical to achieving success in this role and at Toptal.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our team members, and our story.
  • Begin our 1-1 sales training process which conveys our value proposition, sales process, and delivery method.
  • Become acquainted with the cross-functional teams you will work with to close new business.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales training program, including mock calls and role-play scenarios.
  • Be able to accurately articulate Toptal’s value proposition and process.
  • Be able to speak to incoming leads, understand the clients’ needs, overcome any objections, present the value proposition of Toptal, and close leads that are a good fit for Toptal.
  • Work alongside the various business units to ensure your prospects are progressing through the funnel.
  • Begin closing new business, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

In the first three months, expect to:

Com três frentes de negócio: apresentações corporativas, eventos e treinamentos, a empresa entrega soluções completas que apoiam clientes na conquista de resultados estratégicos: desde criar narrativas visuais de alto impacto para vender projetos, até desenvolver conceitos criativos em grandes palcos e formar pessoas por meio de programas educacionais customizados.

A SOAP acredita que a comunicação é um dos principais motores de transformação dentro das organizações e, por isso, investe constantemente em inovação, relacionamento e qualidade em cada projeto. Integrar o time significa atuar em um ambiente colaborativo, dinâmico e criativo, com profissionais apaixonados por desafios e pela missão de elevar a forma como as empresas se comunicam com seus públicos.

O Salesjobs em parceria com a SOAP está em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) Comercial para atuar em São Paulo/SP e compor o time de vendas da divisão de Treinamentos Corporativos. O(a) profissional será responsável por atuar em vendas consultivas, envolvendo tanto a prospecção de novos clientes quanto o desenvolvimento de relacionamentos, identificando novas oportunidades até o fechamento e acompanhamento da entrega, com foco em resultados consistentes e no fortalecimento da marca.

title: Sales Specialist - SASE São Paulo, Brazil, Remote
description:
Overview

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.

As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!

Your Career

SASE is a significant source of revenue and growth at Palo Alto Networks. As a SASE Specialist, you drive the sale of the Palo Alto Networks SASE portfolio - to include Prisma Access, Prisma SD-Wan and Next Gen CASB across a broad geographic territory of Enterprise accounts. Additionally, you work with a variety of other teams to execute the overall SASE Go-to-Market plan, providing thought leadership and enabling scale. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical security challenges facing our customers.

You are required to exceed your quota, obtain/maintain subject matter expertise, create/update detailed written plans, and regularly present to a variety of audiences (large and small, live and virtual).

This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a strategic mindset to take a highly functioning business to the next level. This is not just a career – it’s a meaningful challenge that impacts our lives in the digital age.

Your Impact

  • Ability to work in partnership with your respective geography’s leadership to engage the SASE portfolio to customers, partners, and colleagues
  • Perform high-level sales planning, leading to accurate forecasting of the business
  • Build a fundamental understanding of security threats, solutions, security tools or network technologies
  • Bring to bear all cross-functional resources to achieve your quota.
  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services
  • Conduct in-person sessions, webinars and learning materials that can be consumed by the appropriate audience
  • Identify cross-selling and up-selling opportunities within accounts
  • Educate customers and partners on the modern network security landscape
  • Establish relationships with and sell through channel partners
  • Travel 50% + throughout the territory and to company-wide meetings

Your Experience

  • Consider yourself technical enough to cover some accounts while your SE is busy assisting others
  • Above quota sales experience in a high-tempo culture
  • Experience selling network infrastructure-based security appliances including, but not limited to - Firewalls, SSL/IPSec VPNs, Security Proxies and Caches, SD-WAN
  • Practical experience working with routing and switching products that will be installed adjacent to our appliances
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, both written and verbally
  • Experience working with Channel partners and understanding of a channel centric go to market approach
  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction

The Team

Our sales team members work hand-in-hand with large organizations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients in their journey to security.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

  • Familiaridade com CMSs populares, como WordPress, e habilidades básicas em HTML, CSS e JavaScript;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal;

  • Melhoria contínua: Ter um desejo genuíno de se manter atualizado com as últimas tendências de SEO, participar de cursos e conferências e compartilhar conhecimentos com a equipe;

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Accountant will ensure the integrity of accounting and prepares accurate and timely financial statements and documents, in line with local GAAP and IFRS. Responsible for month end close activities; responsible for performing balance sheet, revenue, expense, and payroll account reconciliations, as well as executing accounts payable and accounts receivable processes.   • To review general ledger accounts and makes necessary journal entries including posting monthly, quarterly and yearly accruals.
  • To prepare and record Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable & Fixed Assets entries by compiling and analysing account information.
  • To post payroll entries, to reconcile of social charges, bonus accrual and pay out.
  • To analyse and review company expenditures.
  • Produce error-free accounting reports and present their results.
  • Participate in financial standards setting and in forecast process.
  • Assist with tax audits, and tax returns and consumption tax returns.
  • Lead, plan, assign and review staff’s work.
  • Ensure compliance with IFRS and FIFA Accounting principles.
  • To provide necessary support for internal customers and external auditors.
  • To seek ways to improve upon accounting processes and procedures.
  • To assist the Head of Finance and the management on special requests.

YOUR PROFILE

Experience and qualifications

  • Degree in Accounting
  • Proven experience (4 years or more) as accounting supervisor and/or senior accountant
  • Experience in an international environment
  • Experience using/maintaining a financial ERP model (e.g. SAP)
  • Experience in Event Finance of advantage
  • Experience in procurement of advantage
  • Good communication skills, ability to communicate effectively in English (oral and written)
  • Very good sense for responsibility
  • Ability to work independently and with a team in a fast-paced and high-volume environment.
  • Focus on accuracy and timeliness, attention to detail
  • Confidentiality
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Based in Rio de Janeiro

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women\'s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Product
description:
TRM is on a mission to build a safer financial system for billions of people. We deliver a blockchain intelligence data platform to financial institutions, crypto companies, and governments to fight cryptocurrency fraud and financial crime. We consider our business — and our profit — as a way to move towards our mission sustainably and at scale.

The Data Product team collaborates with an experienced group of data scientists, engineers, and product managers to build highly scalable features that power TRM's products and services. As a Software Engineer on the Data Product team, you will be responsible for designing and building mission-critical data services. These features analyze and provide insights into blockchain transaction activity at petabyte scale, and ultimately work to build a safer financial system for billions of people..

The impact you’ll have here:

  • Build highly scalable features that integrate with dozens of blockchains.
  • Design and architect intricate data models for optimal storage and retrieval to support sub-second latency for querying blockchain data.
  • Collaborate across departments, partnering with data scientists, backend engineers, and product managers to design and implement novel data models that enhance TRM’s products.

What we’re looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science or a related field.
  • A proven track record, with 5+ years of hands-on experience in architecting scalable API development, distributed system architecture, guiding projects from initial ideation through to successful production deployment.
  • Exceptional programming skills in Python, as well as adeptness in SQL or SparkSQL.
  • Versatility that spans the entire spectrum of data engineering in one or more of the following areas:
    • In-depth experience with data stores such as BigQuery and Postgres.
    • Proficiency in data pipeline and workflow orchestration tools like Airflow and DBT.
    • Expertise in data processing technologies and streaming workflows including Dataflow, Spark, Kafka, and Flink.
    • Competence in deploying and monitoring infrastructure within public cloud platforms, utilizing tools such as Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Datadog.
    • Proven ability in loading, querying, and transforming extensive datasets

About the Team:

  • Our team is spread out over several countries and time zones. To leverage the opportunities and address challenges that come with this working model, we've built a culture grounded in trust, transparency, and adaptability. Even though we're scattered across different time zones, we stay closely connected through open communication and regular check-ins. Our use of digital tools helps us collaborate seamlessly and work at an impressive pace, delivering results at TRM speed while staying in sync.
  • The diversity of perspectives and expertise within our team sparks creative exchanges and enhances our problem-solving capabilities, allowing us to leverage our global synergy to drive innovation and efficiency.
  • We're driven by a deep sense of ownership, constant pursuit of improvement and an obsession with delivering magical experiences to our customers; these are a core part of our culture.
  • We're driven by the desire to continuously hone our craft and to this end, we regularly assess our processes, seek feedback, and embrace iterative development to refine what we do.
  • We structure problems and use the 80/20 rule(for many outcomes, roughly 80% of consequences come from 20% of causes) to identify where to direct our razor-sharp focus.
  • Each of us is passionate about excellence and growth, and we're encouraged to challenge the status quo and experiment with new methods. This mindset creates an environment where innovation is part of our daily routine and every team member is an impact-oriented trailblazer.
  • By celebrating our successes and learning from our setbacks, we stay agile and forward-thinking, always striving to elevate our performance and impact.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • The team received a request from customers to show the running balance for assets tied to an address within the product. They brainstormed to determine the minimal viable solution that could be delivered within two weeks. The team decided to develop a framework that would facilitate enabling this feature for each chain (such as BTC, ETH, etc.) individually. They successfully implemented and tested this solution for the BTC chain and delivered it to customers within the two-week timeframe. This approach allowed the team to quickly provide value to customers and establish a repeatable process.
  • The team was tasked with implementing a new feature that would enable TRM to gather feedback from the user community swiftly. Due to the company's goal of showcasing the feature at an upcoming event, the timeline was tight. The team quickly adjusted to the request, assessed the requirements, and developed a solution that addressed 80% of the needs and could be executed within a very short timeframe. They successfully delivered the feature on schedule, impressing customers with both the functionality and the speed of execution.
  • The team was tasked with developing a solution to reveal Indirect Exposure through cross-chain swaps in response to a competitor's similar feature. Before choosing the technical approach, the team consulted with stakeholders to establish a feasible timeline for the implementation. With this input, the team devised a solution that fit the timeline, communicated the tradeoffs to stakeholders, and successfully delivered the solution as promised.

About TRM's Engineering Levels:

Engineer: Responsible for helping to define project milestones and executing small decision decisions independently with the appropriate tradeoffs between simplicity, readability, and performance. Provides mentorship to junior engineers, and enhances operational excellence through tech debt reduction and knowledge sharing.

Senior Engineer: Successfully designs and documents system improvements and features for an OKR/project from the ground up. Consistently delivers efficient and reusable systems, optimizes team throughput with appropriate tradeoffs, mentors team members, and enhances cross-team collaboration through documentation and knowledge sharing.

Staff Engineer: Drives scoping and execution of one or more OKRs/projects that impact multiple teams. Partners with stakeholders to set the team vision and technical roadmaps for one or more products. Is a role model and mentor to the entire engineering organization. Ensures system health and quality with operational reviews, testing strategies, and monitoring rigor.

Life at TRM Labs

Leadership Principles

Our Leadership Principles are foundational element of our strategy, guiding how we make decisions, how we treat each other, and how we behave day-to-day.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first, driving for speed, focus, and adaptability.
  • Master Craftsperson: We prioritize speed, high standards, and distributed ownership.
  • Inspiring Colleague: We value humility, candor, and a one-team mindset.

Build a Career

Joining TRM means being part of a mission-driven team comprised of industry leaders. At TRM, you'll experience:

  • Purpose and Mission: Have a real-world impact, from disrupting terrorist networks to returning stolen funds.
  • Inspiring Colleagues: Collaborate with industry leaders and learn something new daily.
  • Personal Growth: We're not just using technology; we're inventing it and taking category-defining products to market.

Work Environment

  • Remote First: Our HQ is online. Tools like Zoom and Slack ensure seamless collaboration, but we also value in-person interactions, organizing regular meetups and offsites for team bonding. Clear communication is key in our decentralized setup. With tools like Slack, Loom, and voice notes, we document meetings and decisions, promoting transparency and efficiency.
  • Ownership & TRM Speed : Small teams drive big goals at TRM. Every team member has significant ownership and responsibility, fostering an environment of initiative and direct impact. While there's no strict clocking in or out, we expect team members to balance personal schedules and team needs. We move “surprisingly fast” while maintaining a high bar in service of our customers and mission. This can feel both intense and rewarding. Our unique approach to projects emphasizes quick wins, rapid iterations, and constant feedback.
  • Diversity and Inclusion : Diversity at TRM encompasses backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Every day is an opportunity to learn from a colleague, whether they're a law enforcement expert or a tech pioneer.
  • Annual Company Offsite : Once a year, TRMers come together from around the world to attend a 1-week mandatory company offsite. This is designed to foster in-person relationships, creativity, and strategic alignment. Employee attendance is required of all TRMers.

Join Us

We're looking for team members who love building from the ground up and want to work hard in a fast-paced and ambitious environment. We are remote-first, with exceptionally talented team members located around the world. If you like solving tough problems quickly and seeing your work improve the lives of billions of people, we want you at TRM.

We encourage you to reach out even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Don't worry about picking exactly the right job; we can always explore other options after starting the conversation. Your passion and interests will set you apart, especially if your background or career is unconventional.

To all recruitment agencies: TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM Labs employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.

description:
Chamada para seleção de propostas pesquisa científica: Desmatamento e sistemas alimentares no Brasil

Sobre a oportunidade

1. INTRODUÇÃO E CONTEXTO
A ProVeg Brasil é uma organização dedicada à transformação do sistema alimentar global, visando um futuro mais sustentável para todos, por meio do incentivo de dietas baseadas em vegetais. Reconhecemos a urgência e a complexidade dos desafios ambientais que o Brasil enfrenta, especialmente no que tange ao desmatamento e suas interconexões com os sistemas de produção e consumo de produtos de origem animal.
O Brasil assumiu o compromisso de alcançar o desmatamento zero até 2030, uma meta fundamental para a conservação de biomas de importância global, como a Amazônia e o Cerrado, e para o cumprimento de suas obrigações climáticas internacionais. Neste cenário, a agropecuária é amplamente reconhecida como um dos principais vetores de mudança no uso da terra no país.
Diante da relevância estratégica deste tema, a ProVeg Brasil busca subsidiar suas ações de advocacy e formulação de políticas públicas com evidências científicas robustas.
IMPORTANTE: ESTA NÃO É UMA VAGA DE EMPREGO. EM VEZ DE SE CANDIDATAR ATRAVÉS DO NOSSO SITE, ENVIE SUA PROPOSTA PARA , CONFORME EXPLICADO NA PARTE INFERIOR DESTA PÁGINA.

Detalhes da posição

2. OBJETIVO GERAL
Selecionar a elaboração de uma pesquisa científica para investigar a relação entre o desmatamento no Brasil e os sistemas de produção e consumo de produtos de origem animal, buscando compreender os desafios e as possibilidades para o alcance das metas de desmatamento zero no país.

Responsabilidades

3. ESCOPO DA PESQUISA / TEMAS DE INTERESSE
A pesquisa deverá abordar, de forma abrangente e crítica, os seguintes temas interligados:

  • Desmatamento e Pecuária: Análise da dinâmica e dos impactos da expansão da pecuária (bovina, suína, avícola e outras) e de monoculturas destinadas à alimentação animal sobre o desmatamento em biomas brasileiros, com especial atenção à Amazônia e ao Cerrado.
  • Cadeias de Suprimentos de Produtos de Origem Animal: Investigação do papel de todos os produtos de origem animal e de seus insumos (como a produção de grãos para ração animal, a exemplo da soja) na pressão sobre as florestas e vegetação nativa.
  • Avaliação de Soluções e Limitações: Exame aprofundado do alcance e das limitações de soluções propostas para a sustentabilidade da produção, como a pecuária regenerativa e a intensificação da produção, em relação às metas de desmatamento e à mitigação de emissões de gases de efeito estufa (incluindo o metano).
  • Padrões de Consumo e Produção: Análise dos níveis atuais de produção e consumo de produtos de origem animal no Brasil, considerando tanto o mercado interno quanto as exportações, e suas implicações para o cenário de desmatamento. O estudo deverá explorar cenários e quantificar as transformações necessárias para o alcance das metas de desmatamento zero.

Requisitos

4. RESULTADOS ESPERADOS / ENTREGAS
O trabalho contratado deverá resultar em:

  • Estudo Científico Detalhado: Um relatório de pesquisa completo, com metodologia clara, análise de dados e conclusões embasadas cientificamente. Espera-se que a versão final deste estudo tenha aproximadamente 25-30 páginas.
  • Policy Brief: Um documento conciso e direto, com recomendações estratégicas para guiar as ações de advocacy político da ProVeg Brasil junto a formuladores de políticas, setor privado e sociedade civil.

Benefícios de trabalhar conosco

Mais informações

6. PÚBLICO-ALVO DA CHAMADA
Convidamos pessoas jurídicas (instituições de pesquisa, consultorias, universidades, etc.) com comprovada experiência e expertise nas áreas de desmatamento, sistemas alimentares, pecuária, sustentabilidade, economia ambiental e políticas públicas a submeterem suas propostas.

7. COLABORAÇÃO
A ProVeg Brasil está aberta a colaborar ativamente em todas as etapas do projeto, oferecendo suporte na elaboração do policy brief e na estratégia de divulgação dos resultados. A participação conjunta na publicização dos resultados será bem-vinda e poderá ser acordada.

  • Evaluate Study Design and Methodology: Assess whether the study design and methods are appropriate, comprehensive, and clearly described to ensure that the research can be accurately reproduced in the future.
  • Literature Review: Check whether the manuscript thoroughly incorporates and cites relevant, up-to-date research in the field.

title: Sales Operations and Salesforce Administrator (OTE $80,000/year USD), Sparkrock
description:
Are you passionate about Salesforce, automation, and leveraging AI to supercharge business workflows? Do you thrive at the intersection of technology, operations, and sales strategy?

At Sparkrock, we help social benefit organizations—like nonprofits, school boards, and government agencies—reach their greatest potential through technology. Every day, over 150,000 people use our ERP and product platforms to work more efficiently, freeing up time and resources to focus on the good they want to achieve.

We are seeking a Sales Operations and Salesforce/Certinia Admin to manage Salesforce and Certinia to support business requirements. This role also includes owning financial management system configuration and integrations with marketing, accounting, sales engagement, and document management platforms while ensuring data integrity and optimizing workflows. The manager will partner with Marketing, Finance, and Sales teams to track KPIs, improve forecasting, provide training, and explore AI-driven automation opportunities to enhance sales and marketing efficiency.

In this role, you’ll not only administer and support Salesforce but also be the key owner of Certinia (FinancialForce) configuration and operations. You’ll ensure that our revenue, billing, and forecasting processes are accurate and scalable, and you’ll have the opportunity to expand your expertise by working closely with Intacct and other critical integrations.

If you’re someone who enjoys solving problems, improving efficiency, and enabling teams with better tools and insights, this is the perfect opportunity for you.

Responsibilities

  • Salesforce Administration : Configure fields, objects, page layouts, and record types; build and maintain workflows, flows, validation rules, approval processes, and customizations; manage system security: roles, profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, OWDs; troubleshoot user issues, provide support, and deliver training/documentation.
  • Certinia Administration : Configuration and ongoing support of FinancialForce processes (billing, forecasting, revenue recognition).
  • Systems Management : Monitor and maintain integrations, manage enhancements, and resolve issues (especially Certinia & Intacct).
  • Reporting & Analytics : Build dashboards, forecasts, campaign attribution, pipeline tracking, and ROI analysis.
  • Process Optimization : Document/refine sales processes, automate workflows, improve data quality.
  • Strategic Collaboration : Partner with Sales Ops, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success to ensure KPIs are accurate and actionable.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
  • At least 2 years of experience with direct Certinia/FinancialForce.
  • 3-5 years of proven experience as a Salesforce Administrator.
  • Hands-on expertise with Salesforce configuration and customization, including:
  • Workflows, Flows, and Process Builder automations.
  • Validation rules, approval processes, and assignment rules.
  • Reports, dashboards, and list views.
  • Security configuration (profiles, roles, permission sets, OWD, sharing rules).
  • Integration setup and troubleshooting with third-party tools (HubSpot, Certinia, Intacct, etc.).
  • Data management: imports, exports, deduplication, and maintaining data integrity.
  • Strong reporting/analytics skills (Salesforce Reports/Dashboards, Power BI a plus).
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into system solutions.
  • Clear communicator, able to train and support users across functions.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Administrator Certification(s).
  • Hands-on experience with Intacct (huge plus).
  • Experience with Finance/ERP integrations (Certinia, Intacct, or similar).
  • Exposure to AI tools, automation platforms, or agentic workflow technologies.
  • Familiarity with PandaDoc, Outreach, or Chorus.
  • Experience in SaaS or fast-scaling tech companies.

Benefits

We don’t call them perks; they’re just part of what makes working at Sparkrock great. Below are a couple of highlights:

  • We are 100% remote and global. Live your best life wherever that may be, and never lose out on career opportunities because of it.
  • Flexible work hours. We work asynchronously and don’t care when you’re online, just that you deliver great results and are there for our customers.
  • We are dedicated to your growth with consistent and meaningful feedback, support in achieving your personal career goals, and access to leading-edge tools, playbooks, and technology to amplify your experience.
  • Introductions to thought leaders in the space and webinars on cutting-edge tech hot topics.
  • Stipend to help set up your ideal home office.
  • Focus on culture: coffee chats, happy hours, cooking classes, book clubs, and more!

We strive to build a team that reflects the diversity of the community we work in and encourage applications from traditionally underrepresented groups such as women, visible minorities, Indigenous peoples, people identifying as LGBTQ2SI, veterans, and people with disabilities.

About the role

Hello talented professionals! We’re expanding our pool of talent and invite skilled individuals to apply. While specific positions may not be available immediately, we’re proactively building a network of qualified candidates for future paid partnerships.

If you’re passionate about game development, eager to showcase and improve your skills on major titles, and open to potential partnerships down the line, we encourage you to apply and become part of our expert talent community. We look forward to connecting with you.

A 3D generalist is a multi-talented professional capable of managing various facets of the 3D production process, including modeling, texturing, lighting, rigging, animation, rendering, and compositing. They embody versatility, adaptability, and creativity, making them well-suited for diverse projects and genres.

Here's what you can expect

  • Profile preselection: Our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile to ensure it aligns with our requirements and values
  • Talent Acquisition Interview: Selected candidates will discuss their experience, skills, and fit for the role
  • Online Test: Qualified candidates will be invited to complete an online assessment
  • Technical Interview: Finalists will participate in a technical interview to assess proficiency and compatibility with our team when a project staffing plan is made

We’re committed to finding the best talent to join our growing team and look forward to connecting with you throughout this process.

The Quest

  • Concept interpretation : Translate 2D concepts and references into high-quality 3D models or sculpts with fidelity to the original design while adding necessary details to achieve leveling, style and craftsmanship with minimal direction.
  • High poly modeling and sculpting : Use industry-standard software to create detailed models that tell a story and meet artistic and technical requirements for the project.
  • Low poly and mid poly creation : Create game-ready versions with optimized topology, efficient UVs, and meeting technical requirements.
  • Textures creation : Use Photoshop and Substance Painter to create high-quality texture maps that accurately represent materials and align with project style.
  • Rigging and animation support : Collaborate with animators and riggers to prepare models for animation, providing clean topology and rig-friendly meshes, and help integrate animations into the game engine.
  • Optimization and performance : Optimize assets for performance and memory usage, implementing LODs and other techniques.
  • Asset integration : Export assets and integrate them in a game engine.
  • Efficient time management : Work efficiently to meet phase timelines and delivery dates.
  • Teamwork : Collaborate with other artists to solve problems and communicate about quality, technical, or delivery issues.
  • Punctuality : Present progress daily and/or when requested, and assist in meetings as needed.

The Skills

  • Strong polygonal modeling skills with clean, efficient, well-integrated and leveled models that meet project requirements.
  • Understanding of technical foundations to manage assets for memory and performance considerations.
  • Strong artistic sensibilities related to color theory, composition, scale, design, shape language, and craft basics, with understanding of proportions and industrial design.
  • PBR workflow and efficient/organized texture creation, with understanding of physically based workflows to achieve believable assets and story.
  • Familiarity with game engines such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
  • High degree of self-direction while being a team player with strong verbal and written communication, and openness to feedback.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and proactive approach to technical and artistic challenges in 3D asset creation.
  • Strong knowledge of pipelines , workflows and asset exporting processes.
  • Quick learner of new processes and software as needed.
  • 3–5 years of experience in the video game industry and at least 3 credited games.

Software Expertise

  • Maya, 3ds Max, Blender or equivalent software
  • Unreal Engine 5 and Unity
  • ZBrush
  • Adobe Photoshop
  • Substance Painter
  • Substance Designer is a plus

Required Application Materials

  • Resume/CV
  • Cover letter
  • Reel or portfolio demonstrating the art and technical skills

The Reward

  • Competitive project-based compensation
  • Opportunity to work on exciting and diverse projects
  • Clear communication and support throughout the project duration
  • Flexibility in project timelines and deadlines
  • Potential for long-term collaboration on future projects
  • Transparent and fair evaluation of your work

description:
